correct_completion: I would review the security policy.
full_sentence: If I were the manager, I would review the security policy.
acceptable_variants: I would change the privacy settings.
I would ask the team to check the system.

options.text: I would review the security policy.
I reviewed the security policy yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This is a past action. The second conditional needs 'would' plus the base verb to express an imagined situation.

options.text: I will review the security policy.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' is used for real future plans. The imagined situation after 'if I were' needs 'would'.

options.text: I am reviewing the security policy.
options.why_wrong: This describes a real action happening now. It does not match the hypothetical meaning set up by 'if I were'.

grammar_focus: Second conditional with 'if I were' and 'would' in the main clause
explanation: The stem uses the subjunctive 'were' to set up an imagined situation, so the main clause uses 'would' with the base verb. Ukrainian speakers may translate a real conditional and use a future form, which breaks the hypothetical meaning in English.
translation: Якби я був менеджером, я б переглянув політику безпеки.
